name: Blackbeard Teach

intro.text: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest. Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum. You've heard the song. I'm the reason they wrote it.
I put the men on Dead Chest Island with a bottle each, to see what would happen. The answer is: singing.

win: A fair fight, and a fairer sea. Take the rum.
after: They say my ghost walks Dead Chest on windy nights. I walk it because the rum's gone.
